definitions.explanation: a person who is skilled at speaking, storytelling, or engaging others in conversation

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{話|はな}し{上手|じょうず}だ。
{話|はな}し{上手|じょうず}な{人|ひと}は{聞|き}き{上手|じょうず}でもある。
examples.english: People who are good at talking are often good listeners too.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}の{仕事|しごと}では{話|はな}し{上手|じょうず}であることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Being a good communicator is important for sales work.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{話|はな}し (talking) + {上手|じょうず} (skilled at)

NA-ADJECTIVE USE:
{話|はな}し{上手|じょうず}な{人|ひと} - a person who's good at talking

RELATED ～{上手|じょうず} PATTERNS:
- {聞|き}き{上手|じょうず} - good listener
- {甘|あま}え{上手|じょうず} - good at being spoiled/pampered
- {世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず} - socially savvy
- {褒|ほ}め{上手|じょうず} - good at giving compliments

NOTE:
In Japanese communication culture, being a good listener ({聞|き}き{上手|じょうず}) is often valued as much as or more than being a good speaker.
